3755-4770-6090-6965.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

5147-6553-8207.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

2595-3899-4694-7306.easyPrerequisites: Combine Guildmage does not have summoning sickness.
2595-3899-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2595-3899-4694-7306.description:
Activate Combine Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, causing each creature you control to enter with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1012-4871-5220-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
1012-4871-5220-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

3750-7903.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Dwarves that don't have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
3750-7903.description:
Deal combat damage using three Dwarves. Thorin's first ability triggers three times, creating six Treasure tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat
3750-7903.notes: If an opponent controls a battle, you can deal damage to that battle instead if desired.

2921-3605-4812-6553.description:
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it trigger, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Animate Dead to it.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters, it triggers, targeting Dance of the Dead.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Brotherhood Outcast trigger, returning Dance of the Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it trigger, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters, it triggers, targeting Animate Dead.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Brotherhood Outcast trigger, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

679-2894-3885-7123.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
679-2894-3885-7123.description:
Attempt to draw a card. 
The draw will be replaced by Chains of Mephistopheles, instead causing you to discard Stinkweed Imp. Then, the draw will be replaced by Stinkweed Imp's dredge ability, causing you to mill cards and return Stinkweed Imp from your graveyard to your hand.
Dredger's Insight's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lich's Mastery triggers, attempting to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-1329-1492-7060.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1170-1329-1492-7060.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Welding Jar from your graveyard.
Cast Welding Jar by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

3090-5256-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 2.

4947-5078-5491-6766.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Diving Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Sai triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token and a Map token.
Activate the Map token by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast spells from anywhere except your hand.
Repeat.

141-2034-6476.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} plus enough mana and/or cards in your graveyard to cast Afterlife from the Loam
141-2034-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Afterlife from the Loam.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Afterlife from the Loam, targeting Naru Meha and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Afterlife from the Loam, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

4120-4968-6260.easyPrerequisites: Deathbringer Thoctar has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4120-4968-6260.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, targeting itself, but putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
4120-4968-6260.notes: You may also target your other creatures in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on them due to Vigor.

372-2239-3556.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Flicker exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Ardent Elementalist exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Flicker.
372-2239-3556.description:
Cast Flicker by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Ardent Elementalist and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Ardent Elementalist trigger.
Resolve the Ardent Elementalist trigger, returning Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Flicker.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Ardent Elementalist and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1781-2743-4483.notablePrerequisites: You have cast your commander from the command zone at least twice this game.
1781-2743-4483.description:
Activate Thran Forge by paying {2}, causing Biovisionary to become an artifact until end of turn.
Cast Echo Storm by paying {3}{U}{U}, targeting Biovisionary.
Echo Storm triggers, copying it for each time you've cast from the command zone this game, with each copy targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Echo Storms, creating that  make copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Ghyrson Starn

428-2719-3769-5096.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal exactly 2 damage to an opponent.
Blim does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
428-2719-3769-5096.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Blim.
Blim triggers, giving an opponent control of Protection of the Hekma.
Deal 2 damage to that opponent by any method, reduced to 1 due to Protection of the Hekma.
Ghyrson Starn and Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 6.

2104-2665-4863.notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Revolutionist.
2104-2665-4863.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Revolutionist.
When the token Revolutionist enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

575-2438-4319-5441.notablePrerequisites: Skirk Alarmist does not have summoning sickness.
575-2438-4319-5441.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Granite Witness.
When Granite Witness dies, Yedora triggers, returning Granite Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Granite Witness by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Skirk Alarmist by tapping it, turning Granite Witness face-up.
Granite Witness triggers, untapping Skirk Alarmist.
Repeat.

526-1090-1817.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one nontoken non-Angel creature with base power 4 or greater.
526-1090-1817.description:
Cast Restoration Angel by paying {3}{W}.
Holding priority, cast Double Major by paying {G}{U}, copying the Restoration Angel spell.
Resolve the copy of the Restoration Angel spell.
When the Restoration Angel token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking any non-Angel you control with base power 4 or greater.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Life Finds A Way triggers, creating a token copy of the Restoration Angel token.
Repeat from step 4.

342-577-674-3080.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exhcange of Words enters the battlefield, it triggers, switching the text boxes of Soldevi Simulacrum and Syr Ginger.
Activate Syr Ginger by paying {0}, giving itself +1/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat step 3.

698-3923-5195.notablePrerequisites:
You have gained at least 2 life this turn.
Will does not have summoning sickness.
698-3923-5195.description:
Activate Will by tapping it, reducing the cost of all white and/or blue spells you cast this turn by at least {2}.
Cast Mystic Speculation with buyback by paying {U} due to Will's ability, targeting any permanent.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Mystic Speculation, causing you to scry 3 and return it to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat from step 2.

719-2060-2499-2567-2893.notablePrerequisites:
Fertilid has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
"Plant" chosen with Xenograft.
719-2060-2499-2567-2893.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Avenger of Zendikar's second ability triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

1978-2585-3789.description:
Animate Grim Monolith using The Blackstaff of Waterdeep.
Activate Grim Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Grim Monolith.
Repeat from step 2.

632-1978-2034-4242.notablePrerequisites: Scarecrone does not have summoning sickness.
632-1978-2034-4242.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Scarecrone.
Repeat.

184-4682-4893.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three opponents.
Opponents are unable to pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
184-4682-4893.description:
Activate Faerie Mastermind by paying {1}{U}, causing each player to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers for each opponent you have, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

1558-3775-4231.notablePrerequisites:
You have the initiative.
You have completed a dungeon.
1558-3775-4231.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Safana triggers, creating three Treasure, three Food, and three Clue tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

372-3196.description:
Cast Last Voyage of the _____ by paying {3}{B}.
Last Voyage of the _____'s first ability triggers, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Last Voyage of the _____ to it.
Abdel Adrian's first ability triggers, exiling Last Voyage of the _____ and any number of other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each exiled permanent.
Last Voyage of the _____'s last ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice Abdel Adrian.
All permanents exiled by Abdel Adrian return to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

262-3957-4268.notablePrerequisites:
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
Elemental Mastery attached to Famished Paladin.
262-3957-4268.description:
Tap Famished Paladin to create 3 1/1 creature tokens with haste.
The token ETBs, triggering Kor Celebrant three times, gaining you 1 life each time.
Famished Paladin triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat for infinite creature tokens.
